partially_covered.missing: No explicit property for listing all displayed information about organizations (e.g., contact details, identifiers, attributes)
ValidationConstraint class is present, but no explicit SHACL or mandatory property axioms for D96A directory requirements

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are addressed by the ontology's class/property structure, especially through Invoice, OrganizationRoleAssignment, and Segment hierarchy. Partial gaps for organization attribute display and explicit validation constraints for file format compliance.

strengths: Good use of necessary and sufficient conditions via equivalentClass
Consistent use of functional properties and inverses
weaknesses: No GCAs for complex cross-class constraints
Limited explicit modeling of mandatory EDIFACT/D96A validation constraints
No explicit SHACL shapes or OWL property restrictions for file format validity

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Missing domain or range for some properties (none detected here, but always check)
P7: Inverse properties may be redundant if not used in practice
reasoner_risks: Complex intersection restrictions may slow Hermit/Pellet
No non-standard datatypes detected, so no critical failures expected

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add explicit properties for organization attributes (e.g., contact info, legal identifiers, warehouse details) and link them to Organization and NADSegment to fully answer CQ5.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Complete coverage for organization information display queries.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Define OWL property restrictions or add SHACL shapes for mandatory EDIFACT/D96A fields (e.g., invoice number, GLN, document date) to fully answer CQ13.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Stronger validation support and compliance with file format requirements.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Implement General Class Axioms (GCAs) for cross-class constraints, such as ensuring every Invoice has at least one BuyerRole and DeliveryPartyRole assignment.
Add optional properties for temporal context (e.g., transaction time, period validity) and further subclassing for AgentRole.

summary: The ontology provides robust coverage of the EDIFACT invoice domain, with strong hierarchical modeling and good use of OWL 2 constructs. Most competency questions are fully addressed, but explicit organization attribute modeling and validation constraints require improvement. Overall, the ontology is high quality and ready for further enrichment and constraint refinement.
